title: Progenitor Index entry
description: One mod version, stored at entries/<Owner>/<Name>/<version>.json. It says where the package is and which exact file it must be.

source.description: Where the package file is downloaded from.

repo.description: The mod's GitHub repository, as https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>.

commit.description: The full 40-character source commit the package was built from. Required unless the entry was imported.

package.description: The package download URL: a release asset of the repo, or the Thunderstore download URL of this exact version.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the package file, lowercase hex.

imported.description: True when the entry was imported from Thunderstore rather than submitted by the author.

confirmed.description: True when the mod's author confirmed the listing. Always true for author submissions.
